```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Import data
df_gender <- read_csv("data_gender.csv")
df_citz <- read_csv("data_citz.csv")

# Function to produce bar charts
plotFunction <- function(data, degreeLevel) {
  fig <- plot_ly(
    data %>% filter(Level == degreeLevel),
    x = ~Year,
    y = ~Degrees,
    color = ~Group,
    type = "bar"
  )
  fig <- fig %>%
    layout(xaxis = list(title = "Fiscal Year"), 
           yaxis = list(title = "Degrees Awarded"), 
           barmode = "stack")
  fig
}
```

### Completions by Gender

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Associate's

```{r}
plotFunction(data = df_gender, degreeLevel = "Associates")
```


### Bachelor's

```{r}
plotFunction(data = df_gender, degreeLevel = "Bachelors")
```


### Master's

```{r}
plotFunction(data = df_gender, degreeLevel = "Masters")
```


### PhD

```{r}
plotFunction(data = df_gender, degreeLevel = "PhD")
```


:::

### Completions by Citizenship Status

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Associate's

```{r}
plotFunction(data = df_citz, degreeLevel = "Associates")
```


### Bachelor's

```{r}

```
